title: Card Issuance Eligibility and Issue Terms for the Pocketwire Visa Debit Card
content:
**Card Operations standard: issuing a Pocketwire Visa Debit Card.**

### 1. Eligibility to be issued a card

A card is issued only when the linked personal account is active, its KYC status is verified, and its plan is at or above the lowest plan in the card tier's entry requirements. The Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit also requires the personal account to have been opened at least the minimum account age in its entry requirements before the issue date. That minimum is 180 days.

This is decided from the company's records of the linked Pocketwire Personal Account, the account the card draws on: its status, its KYC status and its plan, all as they stand before the card is issued. A customer's own description of their plan or status does not replace these records.

Lowest linked plan by tier: Pocketwire Visa Classic Debit, Pocketwire Core; Pocketwire Visa Gold Debit, Pocketwire Plus; Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit, Pocketwire Prime; Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit, Pocketwire Prime (plus the account age); Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit, Pocketwire Onyx; Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit, Pocketwire Summit. Plans rank Lite, Core, Plus, Prime, Onyx, Summit from lowest to highest.

### 2. Plan changes after issue

The personal account plan decides which card tiers are open to the customer. If the plan is later downgraded, the customer keeps the cards already issued until they expire or are replaced. The replacement is then issued on the highest tier the plan at that time allows.

### 3. Issue charges, delivery and expiry

- A custom design adds the custom design fee, and expedited delivery adds the expedited shipping fee. Each is charged on the issue date.
- Virtual cards are issued instantly and carry no delivery fee and no design fee.
- A physical card arrives within the tier's standard delivery time in business days, or its expedited delivery time with expedited delivery. It is metal on the tier whose physical card is metal.
- Every card's expiry month is the tier's validity period in years after its issue month.
- A renewal card is issued automatically the tier's renewal lead time, in days, before the expiry month starts. It carries no fee.

### Points of judgement (hypothetical)

| Linked personal account | Card requested | Issued? |
|---|---|---|
| Active, KYC verified, plan Pocketwire Plus | Pocketwire Visa Gold Debit | Yes, because Plus meets Plus |
| Active, KYC verified, plan Pocketwire Plus | Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit | No, because Prime or above is required |
| Active, KYC status not verified, plan Pocketwire Summit | Any tier | No, because the KYC status must be verified |
| Active, verified, plan Pocketwire Prime, opened 180 days before the issue date | Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit | Yes, because exactly 180 days meets "at least 180 days" |
| Active, verified, plan Pocketwire Prime, opened 179 days before the issue date | Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit | No |

*Downgrade case (hypothetical).* A customer holding a Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit card moves from Pocketwire Prime to Pocketwire Plus. The Platinum card stays in use until it expires or is replaced. Its replacement is issued on Pocketwire Visa Gold Debit, the highest tier that Plus allows.
